# Good Activities Examples
# Demonstrates proper activity structure with phases, province filters, and lifecycle hooks

namespace = activities_good

# Example 1: Complete activity with all fields
hold_grand_tournament = {
	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_adult = yes
		gold >= 200
	}

	is_valid = {
		is_at_war = no
		prestige >= 100
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 200
	}

	province_filter = realm

	phases = {
		opening_ceremony = {
			next_phase = jousting_phase
		}
		jousting_phase = {
			next_phase = melee_phase
		}
		melee_phase = {
			next_phase = feast_phase
		}
		feast_phase = {
			# Final phase — no next_phase needed
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		add_prestige = 100
		save_scope_as = tournament_host
	}

	on_complete = {
		add_prestige = 200
		every_participant = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = root
				modifier = grateful_opinion
				opinion = 10
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalidated = {
		add_prestige = -50
	}
}

# Example 2: Minimal valid activity
simple_pilgrimage = {
	is_shown = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 50
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 50
	}

	phases = {
		journey = {
			# Single phase activity
		}
	}

	on_complete = {
		add_piety = 100
	}
}

# Example 3: Activity with complex phase transitions and coastal filter
coastal_expedition = {
	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_adult = yes
		any_held_title = {
			tier = tier_county
		}
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 300
		is_at_war = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 300
	}

	province_filter = coastal

	phases = {
		preparation = {
			next_phase = departure
		}
		departure = {
			next_phase = voyage
		}
		voyage = {
			next_phase = arrival
		}
		arrival = {
			next_phase = exploration
		}
		exploration = {
			# Final phase
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		add_prestige = 50
	}

	on_complete = {
		add_gold = 500
		add_prestige = 300
	}

	on_invalidated = {
		add_gold = -100
	}
}

# Example 4: Activity using capital province filter with lifecycle hooks
capital_festival = {
	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_adult = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
		prestige >= 50
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 100
	}

	province_filter = capital

	phases = {
		gathering = {
			next_phase = celebration
		}
		celebration = {
			# Final phase
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		save_scope_as = host
		add_prestige = 25
	}

	on_complete = {
		add_prestige = 150
		add_piety = 50
	}
}

# Example 5: Activity with holy_site filter and multiple hooks
holy_pilgrimage = {
	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
		is_adult = yes
		piety >= 100
	}

	is_valid = {
		is_at_war = no
		gold >= 150
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 150
		piety = 50
	}

	province_filter = holy_site

	phases = {
		departure = {
			next_phase = travel
		}
		travel = {
			next_phase = prayer
		}
		prayer = {
			next_phase = return_home
		}
		return_home = {
			# Final phase
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		add_piety = 25
		save_scope_as = pilgrim
	}

	on_complete = {
		add_piety = 500
		add_prestige = 100
	}

	on_invalidated = {
		add_piety = -25
	}
}
